allow: PowerShell($py = \(Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($py\) { python -m py_compile lambda_a\\handler.py; if \($?\) { "OK: compiled" } } else { "python not found" })
PowerShell(python -m py_compile lambda_a\\handler.py lambda_b\\handler.py; if \($?\) { "compile OK" }; python lambda_a\\_smoke_test.py; python lambda_b\\_smoke_test.py)

PowerShell($a = Get-ChildItem lambda_b\\build\\pymysql -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '__pycache__' } | Sort-Object FullName; $b = Get-ChildItem gb-document-analysis-patched\\pymysql -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '__pycache__' } | Sort-Object FullName; Write-Output "py files - build: $\($a.Count\), patched: $\($b.Count\)"; $ha = \($a | Get-FileHash | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Hash\) -join ','; $hb = \($b | Get-FileHash | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Hash\) -join ','; if \($ha -eq $hb\) { Write-Output "pymysql IDENTICAL \(hash match\)" } else { Write-Output "pymysql DIFFERS" })

PowerShell($repo = \(Get-FileHash lambda_b\\handler.py\).Hash; $build = \(Get-FileHash lambda_b\\build\\handler.py\).Hash; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead\(\(Resolve-Path 'lambda_b\\build\\lambda_b.zip'\).Path\); $h = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.FullName -eq 'handler.py' }; $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream; $s = $h.Open\(\); $s.CopyTo\($ms\); $s.Close\(\); $ms.Position = 0; $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create\(\); $zipHash = \([System.BitConverter]::ToString\($sha.ComputeHash\($ms\)\)\) -replace '-',''; $zip.Dispose\(\); Write-Output "repo : $repo"; Write-Output "build: $build"; Write-Output "zip  : $zipHash"; if \($repo -eq $build -and $build -eq $zipHash\) { Write-Output ">>> 3개 모두 동일" } else { Write-Output ">>> 불일치 있음" })
